title: Relais memo
description: One Tax & Legal memo written by a KPMG member firm, normalised to a common format. Every field an answer relies on is explicit, so that any answer can be traced back to a passage, an author and a date.

iso.description: Country of the member firm that wrote the memo (taxonomy/countries.json)

service.description: Team or department, e.g. Indirect Tax

email.description: Work address, shown to a colleague who wants to reach the author when no memo answers (level 2)

valid_until.description: After this date the memo can no longer be used for an automatic answer

jurisdictions.description: Countries whose law the memo covers

question.description: The problem as it was asked, anonymised

solution.description: The answer retained, in one paragraph

passages.description: The memo body split into numbered passages; answers cite these word for word

mode.description: auto: may feed a level-1 answer. contact_only: content stays private, the memo only routes the question to its author (level 2)

fictitious.description: true for demo data written by the team
